note: PWA generates a web app manifest at /manifest.json from the pwa.config config object (name, short_name, start_url, display, theme_color, background_color, scope, orientation, icons from file fids, manifest_path_mode/manifest_paths). Form at /admin/config/services/pwa/manifest (route pwa.config_manifest, permission administer pwa); manifest route pwa.manifest (permission access pwa). Service pwa.manifest::toArray(); hook_pwa_manifest_alter. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real pwa.config keys read/written via drush.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal site using the PWA module, at what URL is the web app manifest served, and which config object / admin form configures it?
evals.expected_output: The manifest is served at /manifest.json (route pwa.manifest). It is built from the pwa.config config object and edited at /admin/config/services/pwa/manifest (route pwa.config_manifest, permission 'administer pwa').

evals.prompt: Which permission must a role have so that the PWA manifest link (and the service worker) attach to pages for those users?
evals.expected_output: The 'access pwa' permission. pwa_page_attachments() returns early unless the current user has 'access pwa'; it should usually be granted to all roles with 'access content'.

evals.prompt: How does the PWA module control which pages the manifest link is added to? Name the config keys involved.
evals.expected_output: manifest_path_mode (default 'all_except_listed' = add everywhere except the listed patterns; the include mode adds only on listed patterns) together with manifest_paths (newline-separated path patterns). Empty manifest_paths adds on all pages.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the PWA app's display mode has been changed from its default. Inspect the live PWA configuration and state the current display mode.
evals.expected_output: pwa.config display is 'fullscreen' (default is 'standalone'); read with `drush cget pwa.config display`.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the PWA theme color has been customized. Inspect the live PWA configuration and state the configured theme_color value.
evals.expected_output: pwa.config theme_color is '#123456' (default '#ffffff'); read with `drush cget pwa.config theme_color`.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the PWA manifest so the web app name is 'My PWA App' and the short name is 'MyPWA'. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set pwa.config name to 'My PWA App' and short_name to 'MyPWA' (e.g. drush cset pwa.config name 'My PWA App' -y; drush cset pwa.config short_name MyPWA -y).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the PWA manifest so the installed app launches at '/home' (set the manifest start_url to /home). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set pwa.config start_url to '/home' (e.g. drush cset pwa.config start_url /home -y).
